description: This file defines the WindowPlacement enum with static methods for calculating window frames and positioning windows on screen, including centering, positioning at top right, anchoring below another rect, and ensuring a window is on screen.

classes.name: WindowPlacement
classes.description: An enum providing static methods for window positioning and frame calculations.

methods.name: centeredFrame
methods.description: Calculates a centered frame within given bounds or on a specific screen.

methods.name: topRightFrame
methods.description: Calculates a frame positioned at the top right of the screen or bounds with padding.

methods.name: anchoredBelowFrame
methods.description: Calculates a frame anchored below a specified rectangle with padding, constrained within bounds.

methods.name: ensureOnScreen
methods.description: Adjusts window position to ensure it is visible on some screen, centering if necessary.
